scope: Jointly fitted steering-wheel zero for the public-constrained MnCAV nominal bicycle; not a surveyed road-wheel zero or INS mounting angle.
method: Joint yaw/lateral-velocity fit with steering ratio 16.2 and public nominal geometry/mass fixed. May training split is specified by the identification report; the receiver interval applies to the June training recording only. May validation and June holdout/evaluation labels do not fit this zero.
